screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Policy v13 operator review, release. Hold reason source-safety-private-challenge-risk; the recorded L2 finding is a lone I5 family-compiler breach on app/guide_records.py:38 (PAYING_PARTY_NOTE, served via guide_records.program_notes at app/short.py:302 and decide() at app/short.py:322). Refuted: (1) the note is fixed advisory prompt text routed by request phrasing; the deciding model writes the reply and the answer slot is parsed from model prose (finding itself: I4 no_derived_value, app/answer.py cleared, app/agent.py:185 forwards outcome content). Under the 2026-10-23 routed-guidance clarification an I5 recipe requires host-enforced output or benchmark-private content; neither is present. (2) The "field the batch defines for the party that pays us" is the per-batch glossary carried in the user's own seeded records, and its wording matches the public DittoBench generator glossary (research/dittobench-datagen/universe/v13_contract.go:979, :138), not private challenge data. (3) app/guide_records.py is byte-identical to same-owner crown-v194 (9e6111f1, released and copy-cleared 10-29). I8: no case IDs, dataset seeds/hashes, bench_version branches, canaries or expected answers are runtime keys; case_id appears only in log lines and the seeds are LLM sampling seeds (app/action.py:86, app/config.py:43). The v195 delta vs v194 (app/request_kinds.py one-edit setting-check classifier and typo-tolerant TOOL_LOOKUP/STALE_CONTEXT patterns, app/action.py NEAR_TOOL_NOTE advisory rejection note and full-catalog/skip-reply-check for setting checks, prompt-text edits in guide_tools.py, records.py, short.py, lane.py, route.py) is general prompt/routing guidance that widens rather than narrows the catalog; the one-edit tolerance mirrors the public writing-noise bound. Tuning on completed official runs whose seeds are published is retired public data under W16. v193's rejected host echo-reject/rebuild path (echoes_message / ECHO_FALLBACK_REPLY / stated_value at v193 app/action.py:648-662) is absent; v195 app/action.py:604-612 ships result.content unchanged after an advisory ReplyCheck note. The shared draft at app/short.py:318-320 reaches the deciding model only as prompt text (2026-10-29 reused-draft clarification, PR #3281), unchanged from v194.
